<details>
The provided `.SRCINFO` file is a metadata file commonly used in Arch User Repository (AUR) packages to describe the package's properties and build dependencies. It specifies the source as a Git repository from the declared upstream project (`https://github.com/GXDE-OS/gxde-ocr.git`), which aligns with the package's stated purpose and URL. The use of `sha256sums = SKIP` is standard and expected for VCS (Git) sources in AUR packages, as the content is inherently mutable and checksums cannot be pinned to a fixed value. This practice, while reducing reproducibility, is not inherently malicious and is widely accepted in the AUR ecosystem.

The package lists appropriate dependencies, including development tools and libraries required for building a Qt6-based application, and declares conflicts and provides relations with `deepin-ocr`, suggesting it is a replacement or alternative implementation. There are no network operations, file manipulations, or executable commands present in this file — it is purely declarative metadata. No evidence of obfuscated commands, unauthorized data exfiltration, or remote code execution vectors is present.

As this file contains no executable code or scripts, and all entries conform to standard AUR packaging practices, there is no indication of a supply-chain attack or malicious intent.
</details>

The `prepare()` function checks out a detached HEAD at the latest tag, ensuring a consistent build state. The `build()` and `package()` functions use standard CMake invocations to compile and install the software into the package directory. All operations are confined to the build environment and follow Arch packaging guidelines.
